7.1.1 Accuracy Class - The accuracy classes of 1.5 and 2.5 are covered in this standard ( see also 2.8.2 and 4.1 of IS : 3437-1972* ). 7.1.2 Permissible Intrinsic Error - The permissible intrinsic error under reference conditions and between the limits of the effective range shall be & l-5 percent or f 2.5 percent. 7.1.3
Voltage Range 7.1.3.1 DC voltage range - The instrument shall be capabIe of measuring dc voltages from 1 V full scale deflection up to 300 V full scale deflection in suitable ranges.

NOTE -The use of the IS1 Certification Mark is governed b the provisions of the Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks) Act and the & ules and Regulations made thereunder. The IS1 Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control ISI marked which is devised and supervised by IS1 and operated by the producer. products are also continuously checked by IS1 for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard.
